questions.question: What are the coordinates of the x-intercept of the graph of  2x + 4y = -4  in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: Set y = 0: 2x = -4; x = -2, so x-intercept is (-2, 0).

What is the solution (x, y) to the system  2x + 3y = 22  and  x + y = 8?
questions.explanation: From the second equation, x = 8 - y. Substitute: 2(8 - y) + 3y = 22; (1)y = 6; y = 6; x = 2.
